description: Search Bilibili videos by keyword, resolve video URLs or IDs, read the popular feed, or pull partition, rookie, origin, and weekly ranking charts. Public metadata only; no login or cookies required.

duration.description: Keep only videos in this length range.
duration.title: Duration filter (mode=search)

enrichDetails.description: Add one detail request per unique video in search, popular, and ranking modes to fill tags, coin/share counts, cid, parts, resolution, and uploader followers. Usually adds 3-10 seconds per video, depending on Bilibili latency. byVideoUrl lookups are always enriched.
enrichDetails.title: Enrich with video details

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted video records. Error records do not count toward it.
maxItems.title: Max videos

enumTitles: Fetch videos by URL / BV / AV / b23.tv
mode.title: Mode

partition.description: Search partition filter (mode=search) or ranking chart (mode=ranking). Ignored for weekly charts.
partition.title: Partition

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor starts direct and retries through fresh and anonymous browser sessions; this proxy is used only as the final escalation stage.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration (optional)

publishedAfter.description: Only videos published on or after this date, `YYYY-MM-DD` (mode=search). Can be used alone.
publishedAfter.title: Published after (UTC)

publishedBefore.description: Only videos published on or before this date, `YYYY-MM-DD` (mode=search). Can be used alone.
publishedBefore.title: Published before (UTC)

rankingType.description: All-time, originals-only, rookie, or the weekly series.
rankingType.title: Ranking type (mode=ranking)

searchQueries.description: One keyword per entry, e.g. `python`, `原神`, `Genshin`. Provide Chinese and English aliases explicitly; Bilibili does not translate them.
searchQueries.title: Search queries / aliases (mode=search)

sort.description: Result ordering. `dm` is most danmaku and `scores` is most comments.
sort.title: Search sort (mode=search)

videoUrls.description: Accepts https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV..., https://b23.tv/... short links, bare BV IDs, av123... IDs, or numeric aids.
videoUrls.title: Video URLs or IDs (mode=byVideoUrl)

weekNumber.description: Specific weekly issue. Omit to use the latest issue.
weekNumber.title: Weekly issue number (mode=ranking)

title: Bilibili Video Search, Ranking & Metadata Scraper Input
